prompt: Generate a vertical 9:16 photograph of a British corner shop in near-total darkness, lit only by the cold blue-white glow of a drinks fridge humming in the corner. The shelves are bare except for one loaf of plain white bread, its shelf label reading "£50" in crisp black print. Through the open stockroom door at the back, a small office printing press is running by itself, spilling sheets of fresh banknotes onto the floor in a soft paper drift; an empty office chair faces it, a full mug of tea untouched beside the machine. Nobody is there. Anamorphic lens, oval bokeh, deep negative space, Kodak 500T grain, slow-shutter blur on the moving paper. Thanks.
